lines.line: Summary: The alligator, a big reptile, lives in Bayou Nwa, Bluewater Marsh and parts of Scarlett Meadows. Once its jaws clamp your torso, you die within moments.

quoted: The alligator is a large reptile endemic to Bayou Nwa in Lemoyne. They are also found in Bluewater Marsh and some parts of Scarlett Meadows (particularly around the Kamassa River).
The alligator attacks by clamping the torso of the player with their jaw and swinging them about, killing them almost instantly.

lines.line: Weak points: A rifle shot or thrown tomahawk to the head kills it, and a scope keeps you far away. A bow with poison or improved arrows to the head also works.

quoted: alligators can be easily killed via a single shot to the head by a rifle. Throwing a Tomahawk at its head will kill it instantly.
A scoped rifle will allow the player to kill them from a farther distance without having to risk getting too close.
A bow shot with improved or poisoned arrows directly in the head is also a good alternative.

lines.line: Tips: Kill it on the shore, since you cannot skin an alligator in water. Most lie still there until you get close, and a horse ridden at one throws you.

quoted: Alligators cannot be skinned in water.
It is best to find and kill an alligator lying on the shore.
most just lie still near the shores of Bayou Nwa and only attack or fight back if the player comes too close to them.
Horses get spooked and will throw off the player if he rides towards a gator or gets too close.

lines.line: Summary: A wild boar, most common across Lemoyne and also found in New Hanover and West Elizabeth. It drops a boar pelt, tender pork loin, animal fat and a boar tusk.

quoted: - West Elizabeth - New Hanover - Lemoyne - Guarma
the greatest concentration is all throughout Lemoyne.
- Boar Pelt - Tender Pork Loin - Animal Fat - Boar Tusk

lines.line: Tips: Both a rifle and a bow can give a perfect pelt, using poison or ordinary arrows. A boar cannot be stored on your horse, because it is skinned the way elk and bison are.

quoted: The player can obtain a perfect pelt using either a rifle or a Bow with Poison or regular Arrows.
Despite being classed as a large animal, boars can only be skinned akin to massive animals such as Elk and Bison, and thus cannot be picked up and stored on horseback.

lines.line: Summary: Snakes live nearly everywhere, most thickly in the east around Bluewater Marsh and Bayou Nwa. Most are venomous, and they drop stringy meat, snake skin and a snake carcass.

quoted: Most snakes are venomous and will bite the player if provoked.
The snake can be found in virtually all locations
Higher concentrations tend to be along the eastern regions, especially Bluewater Marsh and Bayou Nwa.
|| Stringy Meat Snake Skin Snake Carcass

lines.line: Tips: Only a bow with small game arrows gives a perfect skin, and a Health Cure removes venom. Any perfect snake skin makes the Rattlesnake Vaquero Saddle at the Trapper.

quoted: To get a perfect snake skin you have to use a bow with Small Game Arrows.
A Health Cure will remove the venom from the player.
The Rattlesnake Vaquero Saddle available from the Trapper
Despite the name, any perfect snake skin can be used to craft this saddle, not just rattlesnakes.

lines.line: Summary: A Lemoyne gang that often robs and kills, mostly around Scarlett Meadows, Rhodes and Saint Denis. Their crimes often succeed, thanks to their manpower and ammunition, which other gangs lack.

quoted: they frequently terrorize the areas of Rhodes and the much-bigger Saint Denis. However, they particularly terrorize Scarlett Meadows
often commiting crimes like murder and robberies
They are regularly successful in their crimes due to their amount of manpower, and ammunition unlike other gangs.

lines.line: Looks like: Grey uniforms in the old Confederate army style, each with a yellow neckerchief.

quoted: Everyone within the gang consistently wears grey Confederate-military styled uniforms, with yellow neckerchiefs.

lines.line: Tips: Under the rail bridge near Hill Haven Ranch, 8 to 12 mounted Raiders can ambush you without warning. Near Catfish Jacksons, they can hit you with a wagon-mounted Gatling gun and reinforcements, with little cover. Certain Raiders at random camps let you keep two hats, the Military Officer's Hat and Military Forage Cap.

quoted: The Raiders can launch a very dangerous ambush under the rail bridge near Hill Haven Ranch. A gang of 8-12 mounted Raiders will storm the player without warning and attempt to kill them. Mortality rates for the protagonist are notoriously high in this ambush.

Another random encounter can occur when passing by Catfish Jacksons. The Raiders launch an ambush on the player with a wagon mounted Gatling Gun, while reinforcements arrive and attack the player. Due to a lack of cover, this can be a difficult fight.
The player is able to equip and keep two unique hats from select enemies in random Lemoyne Raider camps. They are the Military Officer's Hat and the Military Forage Cap

lines.line: Summary: A cruel, territorial gang found around Roanoke Ridge in New Hanover. You usually meet them robbing a camp of travellers.

quoted: The Murfree Brood are known for being unbelievably cruel and territorial
!! Location || Roanoke Ridge, New Hanover
Instead, players usually encounter the Murfrees while they are looting a travelers' camp.

lines.line: Looks like: Often shirtless.

quoted: They rarely wear shirts

lines.line: Tips: Their Volcanic Pistols and double-barreled shotguns make close fights deadly, and they can survive a point-blank shotgun blast. Looting them mostly gives cigarettes, tonics and herbs, but ones in scripted ambushes always carry money. You can also loot throwing knives from them.

quoted: Murfrees are unusually durable compared to other human NPCs, being observed surviving point-blank shotgun blasts, and in some cases even headshots with lesser firearms.
The Murfree Brood frequently use Volcanic Pistols and Double-Barreled Shotguns, making close quarters combat with them a very deadly prospect due to the damage they deal.
the Murfrees don't carry any valuables and players mostly receive cigarettes, tonics, and herbs from looting them.
Murfrees participating in scripted ambushes against the player will always carry money, however.
Additionally, they can be found from looted Murfree Brood members.

lines.line: Summary: Thrown dynamite hits very hard but has low range and low accuracy. You can carry up to 8, and you cannot customize it.

quoted: !! Type || Projectiles
!! Power || Very High !! Range || Low !! Ammo Max || 8 !! Accuracy || Low
It cannot be customized.

lines.line: Uses: Blowing up a train's engine leaves it inoperable, and it can kill some NPCs you normally cannot target. Fish blown out of the water are poor quality and cost you a little Honor.

quoted: Like the fire bottle, it can be used to kill certain NPCs who are normally unable to be targeted by the player.
Blowing up a train's engine will render it completely inoperable.
Dynamite can be used to blow Fish out of the water, thus saving time on fishing. However, not only will the fish be of poor quality, you will lose a small amount of Honor

lines.line: Tips: Every fence sells it after "Who the Hell is Leviticus Cornwall?", and some missions give it out. A Volatile Dynamite pamphlet is in a chest at Hani's Bethel, and fences sell it after "American Distillation". Shooting dynamite or a crate of it sets it off, and you can craft arrows that explode.

quoted: This projectile is available from all fences after completing "Who the Hell is Leviticus Cornwall?", and is given out during certain missions.
The Pamphlet is found at Hani's Bethel, in a chest below one of the wagons near the house. It is also available from any Fence after completing "American Distillation".
Shooting dynamite will cause it to explode. This also applies to the crates of dynamite found around the map and in missions.
It can also be used to craft dynamite arrows, which will explode upon impact.

lines.line: Summary: A thrown fire bottle with high power but low range and low accuracy. It cannot be customized.

quoted: !! Type || Projectiles
!! Power || High !! Range || Low !! Accuracy || Low
It cannot be customized.

lines.line: Uses: Like dynamite, it can kill certain NPCs that you normally cannot target.

quoted: Like the fire bottle, it can be used to kill certain NPCs who are normally unable to be targeted by the player.

lines.line: Tips: Every fence sells it after "The Fine Joys of Tobacco", and you can loot one off enemies earlier. A maxed ammo cart gives two, and the Volatile version does more damage. Its pamphlet is in a chest at a burned-forest campsite northwest of Horseshoe Overlook.

quoted: This projectile is available from all fences after completing "The Fine Joys of Tobacco"
The projectile can also be obtained earlier through looting enemies.
upgrading Arthur's Ammo Cart to max level will provide two Fire Bottles.
The volatile version does more damage and has a better impact radius.
A pamphlet for crafting this variation can be found in a chest at an abandoned campsite in the burned forest, just northwest of Horseshoe Overlook.

lines.line: Summary: The tomahawk is a throwing weapon with moderate power but low range and low accuracy. It cannot be customized.

quoted: !! Type || Projectile
!! Power || Moderate !! Range || Low !! Accuracy || Low
It cannot be customized.

lines.line: Uses: Thrown at an alligator's head, it kills the animal instantly.

quoted: Throwing a Tomahawk at its head will kill it instantly.

lines.line: Tips: Every fence and the Trapper sell it after "The First Shall Be Last". Earlier, you can take one at Six Point Cabin before "Paying a Social Call". You can also find one on broken stagecoaches around Southern Cumberland Forest.

quoted: This projectile is available from all fences and the trapper after "The First Shall Be Last".

Alternatively it can be obtained earlier at Six Point Cabin before the mission "Paying a Social Call" where the hideout would not be occupied yet or can be found on broken abandoned stagecoaches around Southern Cumberland Forest.

lines.line: Summary: A thrown knife with moderate power and accuracy but low range. It cannot be customized.

quoted: !! Type || Projectile
!! Power || Moderate !! Range || Low !! Accuracy || Moderate
It cannot be customized.

lines.line: Uses: Equipped and aimed at an aggressive enemy up close, it can start an instant takedown. A hunting knife cannot do that.

quoted: Unlike the Hunting Knife, the throwing knife and its variants can trigger an instant melee takedown if the player equips it and aims at an aggressive enemy at close range.

lines.line: Tips: "Paying a Social Call" gives you your first, and a fence or the Trapper sells more afterwards. A poisoned one, made at a campfire with Oleander Sage, kills any NPC and scares off dangerous animals. Poisoned knives turn plain once recovered; the improved knife, made with rare bird feathers, may kill outright.

quoted: This projectile is provided during "Paying a Social Call", and can be purchased from a Fence or the Trapper after completion.
the Poison Throwing Knife, also craftable at a campfire, can be crafted with an existing throwing knife and Oleander Sage.
Equipping a poisoned throwing knife and initiating any sort of attack with an NPC regardless of health will guarantee certain death.

Legendary Animals and dangerous wild animals like grizzly bears, cougars and panthers can be dealt with using one poisoned knife attack and they will run away from the player when hit, instead of staying and fighting back.
Poisoned throwing knives turn into regular throwing knives after being recovered.
The Improved Throwing Knife can be crafted at a campfire with an existing throwing knife and rare bird feathers
NPCs can survive being hit with a regular throwing knife while improved throwing knives may guarantee an instant kill.

lines.line: Summary: A two-shot shotgun with high power but low range and low accuracy. Unlike other shotguns, it sits in your handgun slot.

quoted: !! Power || High !! Range || Low
!! Ammo Capacity || 2
!! Accuracy || Low
Unlike other shotguns, this one occupies a holster/handgun slot

lines.line: Uses: Two of them, dual wielded, work very well against people and animals alike.

quoted: Dual-wielding it with another Sawed-Off shotgun is highly effective, allowing the quick and brutal elimination of anything that stands in your way, man or beast.

lines.line: Tips: Your first one comes in "Enter, Pursued by a Memory", and a second costs $85 at any gunsmith.

quoted: it is provided by Javier Escuella during the mission "Enter, Pursued by a Memory". A second one can be bought from any Gunsmith, for the price of $85.

lines.line: Summary: Your starting revolver, a solid all-rounder that holds six rounds. It has moderate power and range, and high accuracy and fire rate.

quoted: this revolver is available from the start of the game.
The Cattleman Revolver is a good all-around weapon for most situations.
!! Power || Moderate !! Range || Moderate !! Rate of Fire || High
!! Ammo Capacity || 6
!! Accuracy || High

lines.line: Uses: Rifling adds range, and a long barrel with better sights adds accuracy. A head, neck or upper-chest shot kills a person outright; torso shots can take three or four.

quoted: It can be upgraded with rifling, which improves the range, as well as a longer barrel and improved iron sights, which improve the accuracy.
It can take as many as 3-4 shots to kill an NPC if they are shot in the torso, unless they are shot in the head, in the neck or in the upper chest, in which case a single shot is enough.

lines.line: Tips: You can buy a second at any gunsmith or take one from slain NPCs. At Honor rank +4 or higher, any gunsmith sells the Hero's Pearl Grip for this gun alone.

quoted: The player can purchase a second model from any gunsmith, or pick one up from slain NPCs.
Once the player has an Honor rank of +4 or higher (75%+ on the Honor bar), the unique Hero's Pearl Grip will become purchasable at any Gunsmith for this weapon only.

lines.line: Summary: A rifle with five rounds, high power and range, very high accuracy and a slow rate of fire. It costs $180.

quoted: !! Power || High !! Range || High !! Rate of Fire || Low

lines.line: Uses: Put a scope on it and it stands in well for the Carcano Rifle.

quoted: With a scope attached, this rifle becomes a good substitute for the Carcano Rifle.

lines.line: Tips: Chapter 3's "Preaching Forgiveness as He Went" gives you one, and every gunsmith sells it afterwards. Killing a bounty hunter in "The First Shall Be Last" gets you one earlier. Lawmen at public executions in Valentine and Saint Denis may carry one.

quoted: This rifle is provided during "Preaching Forgiveness as He Went" in Chapter 3. It is then available from all gunsmiths after the mission.
The rifle can be obtained early in the Chapter 2 mission "The First Shall Be Last" by killing a bounty hunter.
The rifle can sometimes be found on lawmen during public executions in Valentine and Saint Denis.

lines.line: Summary: A sniper rifle: six rounds, high power, very high range and accuracy, quick reload, slow fire. It costs $190.

quoted: !! Type || Sniper Rifle

lines.line: Uses: Its overall stats beat every other weapon, but it only shines when targets are far away.

quoted: In the Overall section (considering the average of its stats and comparing it to other weapons), the Carcano Rifle is the best weapon in the game, both in Story Mode and Online, although it only can be used for unique scenarios where distance matters.

lines.line: Tips: It is free in "The Delights of Van Horn" and "Goodbye, Dear Friend", then every gunsmith sells it. The camera view does not matter: you always aim it down the sights.

quoted: This rifle can be acquired for free during the missions "The Delights of Van Horn" and "Goodbye, Dear Friend"; it will also become available from all gunsmiths after completion of the latter.
It is one of three rifles that the player must look down the sights of regardless of what camera mode you're using

lines.line: Tips: Any gunsmith sells it after "Pouring Forth Oil IV". Chez Porter has a free one in a weapon case, up the ladder in the master bedroom.

quoted: This shotgun is available from all gunsmiths after "Pouring Forth Oil IV".
It can also be obtained for free at any time at Chez Porter inside a weapon case at the top of the ladder in the master bedroom.
